# This script will generate the material for and a formatted report of units from a hierarchical analysis.

For each hierarchical level chosen:
  - mapped distribution of plots and shaded BGCs (OK)
  - vegetation summary table for unit or optionally member site units or subassociations
  - actual edatopic grid unit with plot count and shade cells (extrapolated)
  - summary of environment and climate variables
  - table and figure of related concepts (high similarity)
  - Photo
  - ID type plot
  - Tichy profile(cool but optional)

## Hierarchy representation: Testing HmYc moist poor because it has working order/suborder data
- Maybe add circles for Association colour as legend for map here to make space on the map
```{r hierarchy}
alliance_labels <- BEC.hier %>%
  filter(working_alliance == "HmYc moist poor") %>%
  distinct(
    working_order,
    working_subord,
    working_alliance,
    working_association,
    working_subass
  )

labels <- c(
  paste0("**Order:** ", alliance_labels$working_order[1]),
  paste0("**Suborder:** ", alliance_labels$working_subord[1]),
  paste0("**Alliance:** ", alliance_labels$working_alliance[1])
)

levels <- c(1, 2, 3)

for (assoc in unique(alliance_labels$working_association)) {

  labels <- c(labels, paste0("**Association:** ", assoc))
  levels <- c(levels, 4)

  subass <- alliance_labels %>%
    filter(working_association == assoc) %>%
    pull(working_subass) %>%
    unique() %>%
    na.omit()

  if (length(subass) > 0) {
    labels <- c(labels, paste0("**Subassociation:** ", subass))
    levels <- c(levels, rep(5, length(subass)))
  }
}

plot_data <- data.frame(
  label = labels,
  level = levels,
  y = rev(seq(1, by = 0.1, length.out = length(labels)))
)

ggplot(plot_data, aes(x = level, y = y, label = label)) +
  geom_richtext(
    fill = NA,
    label.color = NA,
    hjust = 0,
    size = 4
  ) +
  scale_x_continuous(
    breaks = NULL,
    limits = c(0.5, 12),
    expand = c(0, 0)
  ) +
  scale_y_continuous(
    breaks = NULL,
    expand = expansion(add = 0.5)
  ) +
  coord_cartesian(clip = "off") +
  theme_void() +
  theme(
    plot.margin = margin(0, 5, 0, 0)
  )
```

## Build vegetation summary
```{r build veg guide summary and export to excel, echo = FALSE, warning=FALSE, message=FALSE}
require(openxlsx)
require(tictoc)
library(stringr)
data.path = "D:/OneDrive - Government of BC/GitHub_data"
author <- "test.assoc1"
assoc.list <- bgcv13 %>% filter(!is.na(Association_Code)) %>% group_by(Association_Code) %>% mutate(n=n()) %>% filter(n>2) %>% distinct(Association_Code) %>% pull(Association_Code)

vegsum.wbk <- createWorkbook()
for(assoc.choose in assoc.list){
#assoc.choose = "assoc-13"
assoc <- bgcv13 %>% filter(Association_Code %in% assoc.choose) %>% select(SS_Label, Association_Code) %>% mutate(SiteUnit = gsub(" ", "", SS_Label)) %>% mutate(SiteUnit = str_replace(SiteUnit, "/", "_"))
su.assoc <- left_join(assoc, su, by = "SiteUnit") %>%  mutate(SiteUnit = str_replace(SiteUnit, "b$|a$", "")) %>% distinct() 
veg.dat.assoc <- veg.dat2 %>% filter(PlotNumber %in% su.assoc$PlotNumber)
# vegsum.wbk <- createWorkbook()
# #bgc.choose = "CDFmmtab2"
# #for(bgc.choose in bgc.list){
vegSum <-
  create_veg_sum_all(vdat = veg.dat.assoc, siteUnits = su.assoc, strata.by = "Lifeform")

indic.order <- build_species_ordering_hier(vdat = veg.dat.assoc, vsum = vegSum, code.lump=lump, siteUnits = su.assoc, hier.level = "Association_Code")
veg.sum.table <- format_veg_table2(vsum = vegSum, spp=taxon.lifeform)
openxlsx::addWorksheet(vegsum.wbk, sheetName = assoc.choose)
openxlsx::writeData(vegsum.wbk, sheet = assoc.choose, veg.sum.table) 
}

saveWorkbook(vegsum.wbk, paste0("./vegsum.tables/LMH77_draft_assoc_tables_", author, ".xlsx"), overwrite = TRUE)

```

```{r climate summaries}
library(tidyverse)

library(tidyverse)

vars <- c("PAS_an", "CMD.site", "MSP", "Tmin",
          "AHM", "FFP", "DD5", "DD18_an")

# Calculate mean and SD
get_stats <- function(df, group) {
  df %>%
    summarise(across(all_of(vars),
                     list(mean = ~mean(.x, na.rm = TRUE),
                          sd = ~sd(.x, na.rm = TRUE)))) %>%
    pivot_longer(
      everything(),
      names_to = c("variable", ".value"),
      names_pattern = "(.*)_(mean|sd)"
    ) %>%
    mutate(group = group)
}

radar_data <- bind_rows(
  get_stats(plot.env3, "All Alliances"),
  get_stats(test_data, "Selected Alliance")
)

# Scale variables to 0–100 using the overall data ranges
ranges <- plot.env3 %>%
  summarise(across(all_of(vars),
                   list(min = ~min(.x, na.rm = TRUE),
                        max = ~max(.x, na.rm = TRUE)))) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    everything(),
    names_to = c("variable", ".value"),
    names_pattern = "(.*)_(min|max)"
  )

radar_data <- radar_data %>%
  left_join(ranges, by = "variable") %>%
  mutate(
    mean = (mean - min) / (max - min) * 100,
    sd = sd / (max - min) * 100,
    lower = pmax(0, mean - sd),
    upper = pmin(100, mean + sd),
    variable = factor(variable, levels = vars),
    axis = as.numeric(variable)
  )

# Close polygons
radar_lines <- radar_data %>%
  group_by(group) %>%
  arrange(axis) %>%
  bind_rows(slice(., 1), .) %>%
  ungroup()

ggplot() +
  geom_linerange(
    data = radar_data,
    aes(x = axis, ymin = lower, ymax = upper, colour = group),
    linewidth = 0.7
  ) +
  geom_polygon(
    data = radar_lines,
    aes(x = axis, y = mean, group = group,
        colour = group, fill = group),
    alpha = 0.12,
    linewidth = 0.8
  ) +
  geom_point(
    data = radar_data,
    aes(x = axis, y = mean, colour = group),
    size = 2
  ) +
  coord_polar() +
  scale_x_continuous(
    breaks = 1:length(vars),
    labels = vars
  ) +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, 100), breaks = seq(0, 100, 20)) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = c("grey50", "red")) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("grey50", "red")) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = NULL, colour = NULL, fill = NULL) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(size = 10),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    legend.position = "bottom"
  )

```

```{r env summaries - SNR/SMR}
# Option 1: All data
jit <- position_jitter(width = 0.5, height = 0.5, seed = 1)
ggplot(NULL, aes(x = rSNR, y = rSMR)) + 
  geom_point(data = plot.env3, col = "grey50", alpha = 0.1, size = 1, position = jit) +
  geom_point(data = test_data, col = "red", alpha = 0.5, size = 1, position = jit) + 
  theme(panel.background = element_rect(fill = "white"),
        panel.border = element_rect(),
        panel.grid.major = element_line(colour = "grey"),
        panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
        aspect.ratio = 1) + 
  scale_y_continuous(breaks = 0:9, limits = c(0, 9))

# Option 2: More heatmap-y
all_counts <- plot.env3 %>%
  filter(!is.na(rSNR), !is.na(rSMR)) %>%
  mutate(rSNR = as.numeric(as.character(rSNR))) %>%
  count(rSNR, rSMR)

unit_pts <- test_data %>%
  filter(!is.na(rSNR), !is.na(rSMR)) %>%
  mutate(rSNR = as.numeric(as.character(rSNR)))

ggplot() +
  geom_tile(data = all_counts, aes(rSNR, rSMR, fill = n), colour = "white") +
  scale_fill_gradient(low = "grey95", high = "grey30", trans = "sqrt",
                      name = "# of plots") +
  geom_point(data = unit_pts, aes(rSNR, rSMR),
             colour = "red", size = 1.3, alpha = 0.7,
             position = position_jitter(width = 0.45, height = 0.45, seed = 1)) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = 1:6, limits = c(0.5, 6.5), expand = c(0, 0)) +
  scale_y_continuous(breaks = 0:8, limits = c(-0.5, 8.5), expand = c(0, 0)) +
  coord_fixed() +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(panel.grid = element_blank(),
        panel.border = element_rect())
```

```{r env summaries - aspect}
aspect_mini <- function(df, min_slope = 5, bar_col = "black") {

  compass <- c("N", "NE", "E", "SE", "S", "SW", "W", "NW")

  asp <- df %>%
    filter(!is.na(Aspect), Aspect >= 0, Aspect <= 360, SlopeGradient >= min_slope) %>%
    mutate(bin = factor(compass[floor(((Aspect + 22.5) %% 360) / 45) + 1],
                        levels = compass)) %>%
    count(bin, .drop = FALSE)

  ggplot(asp, aes(bin, n)) +
    geom_col(fill = bar_col, width = 1, colour = "white", linewidth = 0.2) +
    coord_polar(start = -pi / 8) +
  # scale_x_discrete(breaks = c("N", "E", "S", "W")) +   # label only the 4 main directions
    labs(x = NULL, y = NULL) +
    theme_void(base_size = 8) +
    theme(axis.text.x = element_text(size = 15),
          panel.grid.major.x = element_line(colour = "grey85", linewidth = 0.2),
          plot.margin = margin(1, 1, 1, 1))
}

aspect_mini(test_data)
```
